context: The core framework defined by ISO 27001 for managing information security.
Document listing all controls from Annex A and justifying their inclusion or exclusion.
Plan describing how identified risks will be treated through controls and other measures.
Process of identifying the criticality of business functions and the impact of their disruption.
Documented procedures for maintaining or recovering business functions during a disruption.
Plan for recovering IT infrastructure and systems after a disaster.
Legal contract ensuring confidentiality between parties.
Policy defining acceptable use of organizational assets and information systems.
Authentication method requiring two or more verification factors.
Framework for managing digital identities and access privileges.
System for collecting, analyzing and correlating security events.
Centralized team monitoring and responding to security incidents.
Security testing methodology for identifying vulnerabilities.
Iterative management method used for ISMS continual improvement.
Matrix defining roles and responsibilities for tasks and deliverables.
